name: Mission intervention New
Quotation to Service Ticket Integration
script:
ticket_id = doc.custom_service_ticket

if ticket_id:
    try:
        ticket = frappe.get_doc("Service Ticket", ticket_id)

        # Always update commercial status when quotation is submitted
        ticket.custom_commercial_status = "Quote Sent"
        ticket.custom_requires_parts = doc.custom_requires_parts or 0

        # Only pause technical ticket if work is not already done
        if ticket.custom_ticket_status not in ["Resolved", "Closed"]:
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Awaiting Quote Approval"

        exists = False

        for row in ticket.get("custom_commercial_references") or []:
            if row.custom_reference_type == "Quotation" and row.custom_reference_name == doc.name:
                exists = True
                row.custom_status = doc.status
                row.custom_amount = doc.grand_total or 0
                row.custom_posting_date = doc.transaction_date
                row.custom_remarks = "Quotation submitted"

        if not exists:
            ticket.append("custom_commercial_references", {
                "custom_reference_type": "Quotation",
                "custom_reference_name": doc.name,
                "custom_status": doc.status,
                "custom_amount": doc.grand_total or 0,
                "custom_posting_date": doc.transaction_date,
                "custom_remarks": "Quotation submitted"
            })

        ticket.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(str(e), "Quotation Service Ticket Sync Failed")

------------------------- # UPDATE INCOMING EQUIPMENT # Ownership is deliberately preserved. # ------------------------- if incoming_name: if same_site_swap: incoming_updates = { "custom_asset_status": "Installed", "custom_site_id": outgoing_old_position } else: incoming_updates = { "custom_asset_status": "Installed", "custom_parent_customer": site_customer, "custom_branch": site_branch, "custom_site_id": outgoing_old_position } incoming_updates["custom_asset_name"] = incoming_new_name if frappe.get_meta("Installed Equipment").has_field( "custom_company_workshop" ): incoming_updates["custom_company_workshop"] = None for fieldname in incoming_updates: frappe.db.set_value( "Installed Equipment", incoming_name, fieldname, incoming_updates[fieldname], update_modified=False ) # ------------------------------------------------------------ # OTHER WHOLE-ASSET MOVEMENTS # Existing non-swap workflows are preserved without using # custom_swap_classification. # ------------------------------------------------------------ elif intervention_type == "Asset Relocation": if doc.get("custom_asset"): relocation_updates = { "custom_asset_status": "Installed" } if doc.get("custom_new_branch"): relocation_updates["custom_branch"] = doc.get("custom_new_branch") frappe.db.set_value( "Installed Equipment", doc.custom_asset, relocation_updates ) elif intervention_type == "Loan": if doc.get("custom_new_asset"): loan_updates = {} if str(doc.get("custom_loan_return") or "0") == "1": loan_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Returned" else: loan_updates["custom_asset_status"] = "Loaned" if doc.get("custom_branch"): loan_updates["custom_branch"] = doc.get("custom_branch") frappe.db.set_value( "Installed Equipment", doc.custom_new_asset, loan_updates ) elif intervention_type in ["Installation", "Commissioning"]: asset_to_update = doc.get("custom_new_asset") or doc.get("custom_asset") if asset_to_update: installation_updates = { "custom_asset_status": "Installed" } if doc.get("custom_new_branch") or doc.get("custom_branch"): installation_updates["custom_branch"] = ( doc.get("custom_new_branch") or doc.get("custom_branch") ) frappe.db.set_value( "Installed Equipment", asset_to_update, installation_updates ) # ========================= # COMPONENT REPLACEMENT # Parent equipment remains installed at its existing branch. # The exact child row is updated in place. # Serialized Equipment Component records are updated when present. # ========================= component_replacement_requested = ( str(doc.get("custom_component_replaced") or "0") == "1" ) if component_replacement_requested: if not doc.get("custom_asset"): frappe.throw("Parent Equipment is required for component replacement.") if not doc.get("custom_component_row_id"): frappe.throw("Original component row is required.") replacement_value = ( doc.get("custom_new_component_item") or doc.get("custom_component_item") ) replacement_serial = ( doc.get("custom_new_component_serial") or doc.get("custom_component_serial") ) replacement_brand = ( doc.get("custom_new_component_brand") or doc.get("custom_component_brand") ) replacement_model = ( doc.get("custom_new_component_model") or doc.get("custom_component_model") ) if not replacement_value: frappe.throw("New Component Item is required.") equipment = frappe.get_doc("Installed Equipment", doc.custom_asset) component_row = None for row in equipment.get("custom_installed_components") or []: if row.name == doc.get("custom_component_row_id"): component_row = row break if not component_row: frappe.throw("Original component row not found on Installed Equipment.") old_component_ref = component_row.get("custom_component") old_display_name = ( component_row.get("custom_display_name") or component_row.get("custom_equipment_type") or old_component_ref or component_row.name ) old_serial = component_row.get("custom_serial_number") old_brand = component_row.get("custom_brand") old_model = component_row.get("custom_model") new_component_ref = None new_item_code = None new_display_name = replacement_value # Serialized/individually tracked replacement component. if frappe.db.exists("Equipment Component", replacement_value): new_component_ref = replacement_value new_component_doc = frappe.get_doc( "Equipment Component", replacement_value ) new_display_name = ( new_component_doc.get("custom_display_name") or replacement_value ) replacement_serial = ( new_component_doc.get("custom_serial_number") or replacement_serial ) replacement_brand = ( new_component_doc.get("custom_make") or replacement_brand ) replacement_model = ( new_component_doc.get("custom_model") or replacement_model ) if new_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_parent_equipment"): new_component_doc.custom_parent_equipment = equipment.name if new_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_customer"): new_component_doc.custom_customer = equipment.get( "custom_parent_customer" ) if new_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_branch"): new_component_doc.custom_branch = equipment.get("custom_branch") if new_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_status"): new_component_doc.custom_status = "Active" if new_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_company_workshop"): new_component_doc.custom_company_workshop = None new_component_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Non-serialized component represented by an Item. elif frappe.db.exists("Item", replacement_value): new_item_code = replacement_value item_name = frappe.db.get_value( "Item", replacement_value, "item_name" ) new_display_name = item_name or replacement_value else: frappe.throw( "New Component Item is not a valid Equipment Component or Item: " + str(replacement_value) ) # Update the existing child row in place so the table shows current fitment. if component_row.meta.has_field("custom_component"): component_row.custom_component = new_component_ref if component_row.meta.has_field("custom_component_item"): component_row.custom_component_item = new_item_code if component_row.meta.has_field("custom_display_name"): component_row.custom_display_name = new_display_name if component_row.meta.has_field("custom_item_name"): component_row.custom_item_name = new_display_name if component_row.meta.has_field("custom_serial_number"): component_row.custom_serial_number = replacement_serial if component_row.meta.has_field("custom_brand"): component_row.custom_brand = replacement_brand if component_row.meta.has_field("custom_model"): component_row.custom_model = replacement_model if component_row.meta.has_field("custom_status"): component_row.custom_status = "Active" if component_row.meta.has_field("custom_notes"): component_row.custom_notes = ( doc.get("custom_component_replacement_reason") or ("Replaced from MI " + doc.name) ) equipment.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Update the outgoing standalone component when it exists. if old_component_ref and frappe.db.exists( "Equipment Component", old_component_ref ): old_component_doc = frappe.get_doc( "Equipment Component", old_component_ref ) component_outcome = doc.get("custom_removed_asset_outcome") if old_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_parent_equipment"): old_component_doc.custom_parent_equipment = None if component_outcome == "Workshop for Repair": if old_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_status"): old_component_doc.custom_status = "In Workshop" if old_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_company_workshop"): old_component_doc.custom_company_workshop = doc.get( "custom_company_workshop" ) elif component_outcome == "Returned to Stock": if old_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_status"): old_component_doc.custom_status = "Returned" if old_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_company_workshop"): old_component_doc.custom_company_workshop = None elif component_outcome == "Scrapped": if old_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_status"): old_component_doc.custom_status = "Scrapped" elif component_outcome == "Retired": if old_component_doc.meta.has_field("custom_status"): old_component_doc.custom_status = "Retired" old_component_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Parent-equipment lifecycle history. existing_component_lifecycle = frappe.db.exists( "Asset Lifecycle Log", { "custom_intervention_ref": doc.name, "custom_related_asset": doc.custom_asset, "custom_event": "Component Replaced" } ) if not existing_component_lifecycle: lifecycle_log = frappe.new_doc("Asset Lifecycle Log") if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_customer"): lifecycle_log.custom_customer = doc.get( "custom_parent_customer" ) if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_branch"): lifecycle_log.custom_branch = doc.get("custom_branch") lifecycle_log.custom_related_asset = doc.custom_asset lifecycle_log.custom_date = ( doc.get("custom_end_time") or doc.get("custom_start_time") or frappe.utils.now_datetime() ) lifecycle_log.custom_event = "Component Replaced" if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_event_source"): lifecycle_log.custom_event_source = "Intervention" lifecycle_log.custom_action_taken = ( str(old_display_name or "Component") + " replaced by " + str(new_display_name or replacement_value) + ". Outgoing outcome: " + str(doc.get("custom_removed_asset_outcome") or "") + ". " + str(doc.get("custom_component_replacement_reason") or "") ).strip() if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_component_item"): lifecycle_log.custom_component_item = ( old_component_ref or old_display_name ) if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_component_serial"): lifecycle_log.custom_component_serial = old_serial if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_component_brand"): lifecycle_log.custom_component_brand = old_brand if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_component_model"): lifecycle_log.custom_component_model = old_model if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_new_component_item"): lifecycle_log.custom_new_component_item = ( new_component_ref or new_item_code or replacement_value ) if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_new_component_serial"): lifecycle_log.custom_new_component_serial = replacement_serial if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_new_component_brand"): lifecycle_log.custom_new_component_brand = replacement_brand if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_new_component_model"): lifecycle_log.custom_new_component_model = replacement_model if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_removed_asset_outcome"): lifecycle_log.custom_removed_asset_outcome = doc.get( "custom_removed_asset_outcome" ) if lifecycle_log.meta.has_field("custom_company_workshop"): lifecycle_log.custom_company_workshop = doc.get( "custom_company_workshop" ) lifecycle_log.custom_technician = ( doc.get("custom_technician") or frappe.session.user ) lifecycle_log.custom_service_ticket = doc.get( "custom_service_ticket" ) lifecycle_log.custom_mission_ref = doc.get( "custom_parent_mission" ) lifecycle_log.custom_intervention_ref = doc.name lifecycle_log.insert(ignore_permissions=True) if lifecycle_log.docstatus == 0: lifecycle_log.submit() # ========================= # UPDATE LAST SERVICE DATE # ========================= if ( doc.get("custom_asset") and doc.get("custom_intervention_type") in [ "Service", "Preventive Maintenance", "Calibration" ] and ( doc.get("custom_work_outcome") == "Work Completed" or doc.get("custom_completed_time") or doc.get("custom_end_time") ) ): frappe.db.set_value( "Installed Equipment", doc.custom_asset, "custom_last_service_date", ( doc.get("custom_end_time") or doc.get("custom_start_time") or frappe.utils.now_datetime() ) ) # ========================= # PUSH MI PARTS + INTERVENTION HISTORY TO SERVICE TICKET # ========================= if doc.get("custom_service_ticket"): ticket = frappe.get_doc("Service Ticket", doc.custom_service_ticket) ticket_changed = False for part in doc.get("custom_parts_table") or []: if not part.get("custom_item_code"): continue part_exists = False for row in ticket.get("custom_used_parts") or []: if ( row.get("custom_mission_intervention") == doc.name and row.get("custom_item_code") == part.get("custom_item_code") and row.get("custom_warehouse") == part.get("custom_warehouse") ): part_exists = True break if part_exists: continue ticket.append("custom_used_parts", { "custom_item_code": part.get("custom_item_code"), "custom_item_name": part.get("custom_item_name"), "custom_brand": part.get("custom_brand"), "custom_qty": part.get("custom_qty") or 1, "custom_warehouse": part.get("custom_warehouse"), "custom_mission_intervention": doc.name, "custom_billed": 0 }) ticket_changed = True history_exists = False for row in ticket.get("custom_intervention_history") or []: if row.get("custom_mission_intervention") == doc.name: history_exists = True break if not history_exists: ticket.append("custom_intervention_history", { "custom_mission_intervention": doc.name, "custom_equipment": doc.get("custom_asset"), "custom_work_outcome": doc.get("custom_work_outcome"), "custom_start_time": doc.get("custom_start_time"), "custom_end_time": doc.get("custom_end_time"), "custom_technician": doc.get("custom_technician"), "custom_source": "Mission Intervention", "custom_component_item": doc.get("custom_component_item") }) ticket_changed = True if ticket_changed: ticket.save(ignore_permissions=True) # ========================= # UPDATE MISSION + TICKET STATUS # ========================= if doc.get("custom_parent_mission"): mission = frappe.get_doc("Tech Mission", doc.custom_parent_mission) outcome = doc.get("custom_work_outcome") fault_type = doc.get("custom_fault_type") or "" # Tech Mission = one scheduled visit. # Once the MI is submitted, that visit is completed. # The Service Ticket remains open/on hold if follow-up is needed. mission.custom_mission_status = "Completed" # ========================= # ADD MI TO TECH MISSION DAILY WORK LOGS # ========================= if mission.meta.has_field("custom_intervention_table"): log_exists = False for row in mission.get("custom_intervention_table") or []: if row.get("custom_intervention_reference") == doc.name: log_exists = True break mi_status_map = { "Work Completed": "Completed", "False Call Out": "Completed", "Continue Work": "Completed", "Waiting for Parts": "Completed", "Waiting for Client": "Completed", "Could Not Complete": "Completed", "To Quote (Billable)": "Completed" } daily_log_status = mi_status_map.get( doc.get("custom_work_outcome"), "Completed" ) # ========================= # CALCULATE MI BILLABLE HOURS # ========================= physical_hours = doc.get("custom_hours_worked") or 0 tech_count = len(mission.get("custom_planned_team") or []) or 1 billable_hours = physical_hours if mission.get("custom_count_each_technician"): billable_hours = physical_hours * tech_count billable_hours = round(billable_hours, 2) if doc.meta.has_field("custom_billable_hours"): doc.db_set("custom_billable_hours", billable_hours) if not log_exists: mission.append("custom_intervention_table", { "custom_date": doc.get("custom_end_time") or doc.get("custom_start_time"), "custom_intervention_reference": doc.name, "custom_technician": doc.get("custom_technician"), "custom_hours": physical_hours, "custom_status": daily_log_status, "custom_technician_count": tech_count, "custom_billable_hours": billable_hours, "custom_work_progress": doc.get("custom_work_progress") }) # ========================= # UPDATE TECH MISSION TOTALS # ========================= total_actual_hours = 0 for row in mission.get("custom_intervention_table") or []: total_actual_hours += row.get("custom_billable_hours") or 0 if mission.meta.has_field("custom_total_actual_hours"): mission.custom_total_actual_hours = round(total_actual_hours, 2) if ( mission.meta.has_field("custom_total_hours") and mission.get("custom_planned_starttime") and mission.get("custom_planned_endtime") ): start = frappe.utils.get_datetime( mission.get("custom_planned_starttime") ) end = frappe.utils.get_datetime( mission.get("custom_planned_endtime") ) seconds = frappe.utils.time_diff_in_seconds(end, start) if seconds > 0: mission.custom_total_hours = round(seconds / 3600, 2) mission.save(ignore_permissions=True) # Close Tech Mission ToDos only when mission is really completed if mission.get("custom_mission_status") in ["Completed", "Closed"]: todos = frappe.get_all( "ToDo", filters={ "reference_type": "Tech Mission", "reference_name": mission.name, "status": ["!=", "Closed"] }, fields=["name"] ) for row in todos: frappe.db.set_value( "ToDo", row.name, "status", "Closed" ) # ========================= # UPDATE SERVICE TICKET STATUS # ========================= if mission.get("custom_service_ticket"): ticket = frappe.get_doc("Service Ticket", mission.custom_service_ticket) # Update Service Ticket Tech Mission history row if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_tech_missions"): for mrow in ticket.get("custom_tech_missions") or []: if mrow.get("custom_tech_mission") == mission.name: if mrow.meta.has_field("custom_mission_status"): mrow.custom_mission_status = mission.get("custom_mission_status") or "Completed" if mrow.meta.has_field("custom_work_outcome"): mrow.custom_work_outcome = outcome or "" if mrow.meta.has_field("custom_fault_type"): mrow.custom_fault_type = fault_type if mrow.meta.has_field("custom_notes"): mrow.custom_notes = doc.get("custom_work_progress") or "" if mrow.meta.has_field("custom_planned_starttime"): mrow.custom_planned_starttime = doc.get("custom_planned_starttime") if mrow.meta.has_field("custom_planned_endtime"): mrow.custom_planned_endtime = doc.get("custom_planned_endtime") if mrow.meta.has_field("custom_actual_starttime"): mrow.custom_actual_starttime = doc.get("custom_start_time") if mrow.meta.has_field("custom_actual_endtime"): mrow.custom_actual_endtime = doc.get("custom_end_time") break # Actual technical classification from the submitted MI if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_actual_ticket_type"): ticket.custom_actual_ticket_type = ( doc.get("custom_intervention_type") or "" ) # Ticket KPI snapshot if fault_type and ticket.meta.has_field("custom_fault_type"): ticket.custom_fault_type = fault_type if outcome == "False Call Out" and ticket.meta.has_field("custom_false_call"): ticket.custom_false_call = 1 if outcome in ["Work Completed", "False Call Out"]: ticket.custom_ticket_status = "Resolved" ticket.custom_hold_reason = "" if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_resolution_source_mi"): ticket.custom_resolution_source_mi = doc.name if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_resolution_date"): ticket.custom_resolution_date = ( doc.get("custom_end_time") or doc.get("custom_completed_time") or frappe.utils.now_datetime() ) if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_resolved_by"): ticket.custom_resolved_by = ( doc.get("custom_technician") or frappe.session.user ) if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_resolution_details"): ticket.custom_resolution_details = ( doc.get("custom_work_progress") or "" ) elif outcome == "Waiting for Parts": ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold" ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Waiting for Parts" elif outcome == "Waiting for Client": ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold" ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Waiting for Client" elif outcome == "Continue Work": ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold" ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Follow-up Required" elif outcome == "Could Not Complete": ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold" ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Could Not Complete" elif outcome == "To Quote (Billable)": ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold" ticket.custom_hold_reason = "To Quote" if ticket.meta.has_field("custom_commercial_status"): ticket.custom_commercial_status = "To Quote" else: ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold" ticket.custom_hold_reason = outcome or "Pending" ticket.save(ignore_permissions=True)
